api_inventory.method: go doc -all at the frozen revision

risk_adaptation.unsafe_scope: The bridge passes owned strings and serializes outputs, so upstream zero-copy byte aliases never cross the process boundary.
risk_adaptation.lifetime_scope: Each response snapshots parser, scanner, pool, or arena values before the next reuse operation invalidates them.
risk_adaptation.resource_scope: The bridge caps lines at 256 KiB, JSON text at 128 KiB, paths and batches, recursive depth at 32, and snapshots/builds at 2048 nodes.
risk_adaptation.concurrency_scope: The contract uses each mutable parser, scanner, pool checkout, arena, object, and value sequentially as required by the public API.

private_assertion_classes: parse and validate success and error behavior
permissive parser numbers versus strict validation
JSON type, scalar conversion, escape, numeric spelling, and compact marshal behavior
duplicate object key order and nested array snapshots
bounded object and array path lookup plus package-level helpers
whitespace-delimited scanner success and malformed-stream errors
object replacement, insertion, deletion, array extension, null gaps, and shifting
arena recursive construction and cache reset
parser-pool reuse across changing object and array shapes
structured bridge errors for malformed and unknown operations
